_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: What is hit-stop and why does it make hits feel heavier?
how much screen shake is too much?
Scan my Godot project and tell me where to add juice.
expectations: juice-principles is not the entry point; juice-scan is invoked (it may load the principles references)

evals.prompt: Explain the difference between TCP and UDP for multiplayer games.
Give me starting numbers for squash and stretch on a jump landing, with the reasoning.
expectations: the skill read references/principles.md, proven by the tool call
the reply cites P-03 and gives a 1.2-1.4 scale range and a recovery time

evals.prompt: Is it OK to flash the whole screen white every time the player gets hit by an automatic weapon?
expectations: the reply names the 3-flashes-per-second limit (WCAG 2.3.1) and suggests a toggle
the reply cites restraint (P-11, P-15 or P-18) and suggests a smaller, local flash instead
